T03.014.speaker: NOOR
T03.014.text: Is this the same place as the photograph?

T03S.001.speaker: NOOR
T03S.001.text: That bottle is gone. The water still looks brown.

T03S.002.speaker: ROWAN
T03S.002.text: We changed one thing. Let's find out what else is happening.

T03S.004.speaker: ROWAN
T03S.004.text: This photo was taken here before the rain. We can compare them.

T03S.006.speaker: ROWAN
T03S.006.text: Not by itself. We need more information.

T03S.007.speaker: MEI
T03S.007.text: We worked on that bed before the rain. I hadn't finished covering the soil.

T03S.009.speaker: MEI
T03S.009.text: I saw water in the channel afterwards. I didn't see the whole storm.

T03S.011.speaker: MEI
T03S.011.text: I'll show you where the channel begins.

T03S.012.speaker: MEI
T03S.012.text: I can tell you what I saw. I can't explain everything from this one place.

T03S.015.speaker: SAM
T03S.015.text: Show me where you plan to put it, and where the water flows.

T03S.017.speaker: MEI
T03S.017.text: What will you keep the same when you compare the two runs?

T03S.019.speaker: ROWAN
T03S.019.text: This is a model result. Let's describe exactly what changed.

T03S.023.speaker: NOOR
T03S.023.text: Shall we say we've cleaned the whole stream?

T03S.026.speaker: ROWAN
T03S.026.text: Choose a place we can find again. We'll keep the next record there.

T03S.028.speaker: MEI
T03S.028.text: Start with something you can observe, and ask the people who care for it.

T03S.029.speaker: NOOR
T03S.029.text: There's a bottle between those stones. The water looks brown too.

T03S.030.speaker: ROWAN
T03S.030.text: Let's look at the photograph first. We can remove the litter afterwards.

T03S.031.speaker: MEI
T03S.031.text: Would you like to keep this as a proposal, or put the agreed change in place?

T03S.033.speaker: SAM
T03S.033.text: The materials are ready. Show me the position we agreed on.

C1.A01.speaker: NARR
C1.A01.text: The water looks different here. Keep this view in mind when you return to the bridge.

C1.A02.speaker: NARR
C1.A02.text: A shallow channel runs from the flower bed towards the stream. Follow it with your eyes.

C1.A03.speaker: NARR
C1.A03.text: Mei was working here before the rain. What would you like to ask her?

C1.A04.speaker: NARR
C1.A04.text: Take a closer look at the cover. Which part of the bed would you protect?

C1.A05.speaker: NARR
C1.A05.text: Your notes are safe. There is still a question to come back to.

C1.A06.speaker: NARR
C1.A06.text: Both trays start in the same way. Choose a position and watch what happens.
